import subprocess,sys,json
subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-m','pip','install','--quiet','lark'],check=True)
from lark import Lark
baseline=r'''start: statement
?statement: record_decl | interface_decl | rule_decl | cycle_decl
record_decl: "record" IDENT "{" field* "}"
interface_decl: "interface" IDENT "{" field* "}"
field: IDENT ":" type_expr ";"?
?type_expr: IDENT "?"? | "Set" "<" type_expr ">" | "Map" "<" type_expr "," type_expr ">" | "Ordered" "<" type_expr ">"
rule_decl: "rule" expr
cycle_decl: "cycle" "(" [params] ")" "{" action_stmt* "}"
params: IDENT ("," IDENT)*
action_stmt: [IDENT "="] expr ";"?
?expr: primary (OP primary)*
?primary: QID | NUMBER | "{" [expr ("," expr)*] "}" | call
call: QID "(" [expr ("," expr)*] ")"
OP: "="|"!="|"=="|"->"|"|"|"+"|"-"|"*"|"/"|"&&"|"||"|"iff"|"requires"|"in"|"subset_of"|"=>"
QID: IDENT ("." IDENT)*
IDENT: /[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_-]*/
NUMBER: /-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?/
%import common.WS
%ignore WS'''
patched=r'''start: statement
?statement: record_decl | interface_decl | rule_decl | cycle_decl
record_decl: "record" IDENT "{" field* "}"
interface_decl: "interface" IDENT "{" (field|method_decl)* "}"
field: IDENT ":" type_expr ";"?
method_decl: IDENT "(" [typed_params] ")" "->" type_expr ";"?
typed_params: IDENT ":" type_expr ("," IDENT ":" type_expr)*
?type_expr: union_type
?union_type: type_atom ("|" type_atom)*
?type_atom: IDENT "?"? | "Set" "<" type_expr ">" | "Map" "<" type_expr "," type_expr ">" | "Ordered" "<" type_expr ">"
rule_decl: "rule" expr
cycle_decl: "cycle" "(" [params] ")" "{" stmt* "}"
params: IDENT ("," IDENT)*
?stmt: if_stmt | action_stmt
if_stmt: "if" QID "{" action_stmt* "}"
action_stmt: [IDENT "="] expr ";"?
?expr: primary ((OP|REL) primary)*
?primary: QID | NUMBER | "{" [expr ("," expr)*] "}" | call
call: QID "(" [expr ("," expr)*] ")"
OP: "="|"!="|"=="|"->"|"|"|"+"|"-"|"*"|"/"|"&&"|"||"|"iff"|"requires"|"in"|"subset_of"|"=>"|">"|"<"|">="|"<="
REL: /(never_implies|may_reference|requires)/
QID: IDENT ("." IDENT)*
IDENT: /[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_-]*/
NUMBER: /-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?/
%import common.WS
%ignore WS'''
B=Lark(baseline,parser='lalr')
P=Lark(patched,parser='lalr')
cases=[('union','record ProvAtom {source:EvidenceRef;polarity:POS|NEG;role:Symbol}'),('comparison','rule diff>0 => ADD_OR_STRENGTHEN'),('method','interface Projectable {semantic_hash:Hash;projection(reader:ReaderId)->Ref}'),('relation','rule Delta never_implies epistemic_upgrade'),('if','cycle(input,node){if residual.effect {receipt=Needle.execute(effect_intent)}}')]
out=[]
for name,src in cases:
 def ok(parser):
  try:return True,parser.parse(src).pretty()
  except Exception as e:return False,str(e).split('\n')[0]
 bo,bd=ok(B);po,pd=ok(P)
 semantic_baseline=bo and (name!='if' or 'if_stmt' in bd)
 semantic_patched=po and (name!='if' or 'if_stmt' in pd)
 out.append({'case':name,'baseline_parse':bo,'baseline_semantic':semantic_baseline,'patched_parse':po,'patched_semantic':semantic_patched})
neg='record Broken {x:Set<Ref}'
def accepts(parser,s):
 try:parser.parse(s);return True
 except:return False
print(json.dumps({'cases':out,'negative_baseline_accept':accepts(B,neg),'negative_patched_accept':accepts(P,neg),'expected':{'baseline_current_fail_or_misparse':5,'patched_pass':5,'negative_rejected':True}},sort_keys=True))
